title: Oracle machine run
statement: Given an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine, an oracle language, a finite sequence of nondeterministic choice bits, and an input string, the run is the configuration obtained by processing those bits in order from the machine's initial configuration on the input.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle language over its symbol alphabet
A finite sequence of Boolean choice bits
